text: dsh-web-notify 为 DSH Web 客户端添加浏览器通知。它通过会话投影记录回合结束状态，并观察网页中的会话变化；当用户未专注该会话时，可提醒回合完成、阻塞、错误，以及等待审批、回答或计划审查。点击通知会聚焦页面并打开对应会话。设置页可申请浏览器通知权限并发送测试通知。插件不需要 API 密钥，也不调用外部服务。

dsh-web-notify adds browser notifications to DSH Web. It observes sessions and reports finished, blocked, or errored turns and pending approvals, questions, or reviews. Clicking a notice opens its session. Settings request permission and send a test notice. No API key or external service is needed.
想让 DSH 网页在会话完成时提醒我。
DSH 等待我审批或回答时，能不能发浏览器通知？
Notify me when a DSH Web session finishes or needs my attention.
dsh-web-notify 的功能「会话状态通知」：当未处于当前专注会话时，浏览器可显示回合完成、阻塞、错误或等待用户操作的通知；点击通知会打开对应会话。
dsh-web-notify alerts: Browser notices report finished turns or pending input; clicking opens the session.

dsh-web-notify README · dsh-web-notify：English | [日本語](README.ja.md)

A community plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI that sends browser/OS notifications when a session completes, errors, becomes blocked, or waits for user interaction.

> This is a community-maintained plugin, not part of the DeepSeek Harness core distribution.

dsh-web-notify README · What it does：The host side registers a `notifyTurn` session projection. The Web client observes session state and uses the browser Notification API to notify for:

- a non-visible session ending as `completed`, `blocked`, or `error`;
- a session waiting for `approval`, `question`, or `plan-review`.

Notifications are suppressed when the relevant conversation is already visible and focused.

dsh-web-notify README · Compatibility：Real-session completion and waiting-for-interaction notification firing on **0.2.1-alpha.3** is verified as listed (stop and interrupt do not notify). In the scripted browser, the notification permission and the not-attended gate were exercised through page-side overrides; the granted-permission display itself was checked in a real browser the same day. Real-session firing from **error**/**blocked** end states has not been triggered in this pass, and on **0.2.1-rc.1** the stop/interrupt suppression and aggregated-notification display were not re-triggered (no notification-logic changes since the alpha.3 pass; the only edits were Japanese copy strings). dsh-web-notify README · Install：Install dependencies and build the client bundle:

```sh
npm install
npm run build
```

Add the local checkout to the Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add <absolute-path-to-this-repository>
```

Restart DSH Web after installation.

dsh-web-notify README · Settings：Open **Settings → General → Browser notifications**.

- When permission is not decided, request browser notification permission.
- When permission is granted, send a test notification.
- Revoke permission from the browser's site settings.

Copy language follows the browser's preferred languages, not the DSH Language setting. The first usable preference decides: `ja` renders Japanese, anything else renders English.

dsh-web-notify README · Privacy and notification content：OS notification centers and lock screens may display notification content.

This plugin intentionally limits notification text to:

- a generic `DSH` title prefix plus a short state label such as `Completed`, `Error`, or `Waiting for approval` in English, and its Japanese counterpart in a Japanese browser session;
- generic counts for aggregated notifications.

dsh-web-notify README · Privacy and notification content：It does **not** show the DSH session display title, LLM output, command text, or full filesystem paths, so a session name holding customer or project names is not exposed on the OS lock screen. The plugin declares no dedicated capability; it reads only the session id and the session finish/wait states as fixed enum values (completed, error, blocked, approval, …), and hands the OS notification nothing but a generic title, a fixed status label, and fixed status copy. Clicking a notification opens the affected session (the plugin passes only its session id there), which is how a notification is tied back to it.
dsh-web-notify README · Privacy and notification content：The plugin does not send notification data to an external service. Notifications are created locally through the browser Notification API.

dsh-web-notify README · Build and test：```sh
npm run build
npm run check
npm test
```

`npm run build` regenerates `lib/client.js` with esbuild. Rebuild after changing client source.

dsh-web-notify README · Build and test：The runtime `zod` dependency is declared as `^4.6.6` so the lockfile resolves past GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 / CVE-2023-54404 (memory exhaustion while validating array schemas without a length bound, fixed in 4.6.6). This plugin validates no array schemas (`src/projection.js` uses only object, number, and string), so the vulnerable path is not reachable from its code.

dsh-web-notify README · Limitations：- Browser notification permission is required and is scoped to the browser origin.
- Notifications are available only while the DSH page is loaded and connected; this plugin does not implement offline push notifications.
- DSH is evolving rapidly, so extension contracts can change between prerelease versions.
- Copy language is chosen once when the client module loads; changing the browser's preferred languages takes effect on the next page reload.

dsh-web-notify README · Contributing：Bug reports and focused pull requests are welcome. For notification failures, include the DSH version, browser, operating system, relevant session state, and whether the page was visible/focused.
